title: Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure (LAAC / Watchman)

change_log.author: CarePolicyGuard Regulatory Informatics
change_log.summary: Statutory citation mapping against CMS Pub 100-03 Manual Section 220.13.

description: CMS coverage for Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure (LAAC) for patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation at high stroke risk who are unsuitable for long-term oral anticoagulation.
scope_note: Curated benchmark criterion schema targeting primary statutory indications, exclusions, and waiting periods; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation with High Stroke Risk (CHA2DS2-VASc >= 3)
criteria.description: Documented non-valvular atrial fibrillation with high thromboembolic stroke risk (CHA2DS2-VASc score >= 2 for men or >= 3 for women).
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm clinical indication for stroke risk reduction in non-valvular AF
criteria.source_paragraph: Paragraph 1: Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation with Stroke Risk
criteria.source_text_excerpt: A CHADS2 score >= 2 or CHA2DS2-VASc score >= 3 indicating high stroke risk in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation.

criteria.name: Contraindication to Long-Term Oral Anticoagulation (HAS-BLED >= 3)
criteria.description: Documented formal contraindication or clinical rationale demonstrating patient is unsuitable for long-term oral anticoagulation (e.g. major recurrent bleed, HAS-BLED >= 3).
criteria.clinical_intent: Establish necessity of device-based closure over medical anticoagulation
criteria.source_text_excerpt: A formal clinical rationale establishing that the patient is unsuitable for long-term oral anticoagulation.

criteria.name: Pre-Procedural Imaging Verifying Absence of LA Thrombus
criteria.description: TEE or CTA within 48 hours of procedure confirming absence of intracardiac or left atrial appendage thrombus and appropriate ostial anatomy.
criteria.clinical_intent: Ensure safety of percutaneous transseptal puncture and closure deployment
entity_names: confirms absence of left atrial thrombus
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Pre-procedural imaging confirming the absence of intracardiac thrombus prior to transcatheter transseptal puncture.
